title: EC2 instance allows IMDSv1
evidence: Instance metadata does not require session tokens (HttpTokens != required)
remediation: Set HttpTokens=required (IMDSv2) on the instance.

title: Lambda environment variable names suggest embedded secrets
evidence: Variable name(s) look like secrets: ['DB_PASSWORD'] (values not read into the report)
remediation: Store secrets in Secrets Manager/SSM and read them at run time.

title: Active access key is older than the allowed age
evidence: Active key(s) older than 90 days: AKIA**** (200d)
remediation: Create a new key, switch applications over, then deactivate and delete the old key.

title: S3 bucket has no default encryption
evidence: No default server-side encryption configuration
remediation: Enable default encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS) on the bucket.

title: RDS storage is not encrypted
evidence: StorageEncrypted = false
remediation: Restore from an encrypted snapshot copy; enable encryption for new instances.

title: S3 bucket versioning is disabled
evidence: Versioning is not enabled, so overwritten/deleted objects cannot be recovered
remediation: Enable bucket versioning (and a lifecycle rule to control cost).

title: EBS volume is not encrypted
